data.name: GOBLINS! GOBLINS! GOBLINS!
data.detailed_description:
Unleash your inner goblin mode in GOBLINS! GOBLINS! GOBLINS! Grab your friends and cause chaos in online co-op for up to 4 players. Climb rooftops, smash through windows, dodge guards, steal shinies, and ruin everything for everyone. Work together to pull off the perfect heist… or betray your friends for a slightly shinier hat.

Cause Chaos

Cause mischief and mayhem by ruining public property, weaponizing the local environment, gorging on tasty food, and stealing treasures!… or simply taking them from your fellow goblins.

Goblin Together Strong

Climb and jump over rooftops together, squeeze through tiny openings, and reach even greater heights using the sophisticated and highly inventive Goblin Stacking technique. Lift your friends up to reach inaccessible places… or abandon them completely when the guards show up.

Reject Society, Go Goblin Mode

Take daring risks and straight-up stupid decisions to complete challenges that unlock new goblin customization options such as ears, noses, faces, outfits and hats.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS:  Windows 10 (64-BIT Required)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7600K or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1660 or AMD Radeon RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-BIT Required)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10600KF or AMD Ryzen 5 3600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5600XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended
